findings.title: Dormant public booking/portal RPCs are correctly deny-by-default
findings.evidence: public_cancel_booking_v1, public_center_info_v1, public_client_portal_login_v1, public_client_portal_profile_v2, public_create_booking_v1, public_list_services_v1, public_list_staff_v1, public_reschedule_booking_v1, public_taken_slots_v1 have no PUBLIC, anon, or authenticated EXECUTE grant and their pages are not registered in src/routes.tsx.
findings.remediation: No change. Re-audit grants, rate limiting, and abuse controls before enabling the public routes.

findings.title: Scanner limitation (manual review): dynamic-from
findings.remediation: Manually confirm this construct against the canonical schema.

findings.title: btree_gist exclusion constraint is canonical-only (replay surrogate)
findings.evidence: appointments_no_scheduled_staff_overlap EXCLUDE requires btree_gist gist `=` opclass, unavailable in PGlite.
findings.remediation: No code change; the constraint exists in the canonical migration and applies in Supabase.

findings.title: RPC return shapes (jsonb/record) are untyped at rest
findings.evidence: Several RPCs return jsonb or record (e.g. process_checkout_v1, public_*_v1) and the frontend reads specific fields; generated types cannot fully guarantee these shapes.
findings.remediation: Add typed DTO/mapper + runtime contract tests for non-table RPC results.
